description: Use this after the user has mailed their side of an active Handshake, to record the carrier and tracking number. The other side is emailed it with a link to the carrier's tracking page, and both see it in get_handshake (shipments). Calling it again corrects the number. Nothing is bought or charged; postage is bought outside TraydStar.

carrier.description: The carrier. Optional: guessed from the number's shape when it can be; required when it can't

handshake_id.description: The active Handshake the item was mailed for

tracking_number.description: The tracking number exactly as printed on the receipt or label

name: add_tracking_number
title: Add a tracking number
